2609.08943.title: Evaluating and Improving Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking in LLMs via Multi-Round Evidence Ablation
2609.08943.paper_summary: Automatic fact-checking systems assess the veracity of claims given evidence from relevant documents. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in fact-checking due to their general reasoning capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether they faithfully make use of the evidence provided to reach veracity judgments or rely on parametric knowledge. To investigate this, we introduce Fact-Ablated Evaluation (FAE), a new evaluation framework that iteratively ablates the cited evidence to assess whether LLMs revise their predictions accordingly. Our empirical results show that current off-the-shelf LLMs as fact-checking systems rely more on their parametric knowledge than on the evidence provided. To bridge this gap between prediction accuracy and evidence grounding, we propose REAL (Rigorous Evidence Ablation Learning), a training framework that promotes evidence-dependent verification through counterfactual evidence supervision for the LLM-as-verifier models. Experiments on four fact-checking datasets across different domains demonstrate that models trained with REAL obtain superior evidence-dependent capabilities compared to standard fine-tuned models. Our findings highlight that strong fact-checking performance can still coexist with weak evidence dependency, while REAL encourages veracity predictions to remain more closely tied to the availability of supporting evidence.
2609.08943.paper_summary_zh: 自動事實查核系統評估在相關文件中提供的證據下主張的真實性。大型語言模型（LLMs）因其一般推理能力而在事實查核中展現出強大的表現。然而，目前尚不清楚它們是否忠實地利用所提供的證據來達成真實性判斷，或是依賴參數知識。為了調查這一點，我們引入了事實消融評估（FAE），這是一個新的評估框架，通過迭代消融引用的證據來評估LLMs是否相應地修正其預測。我們的實證結果顯示，當前現成的LLMs作為事實查核系統更依賴其參數知識，而非所提供的證據。為了縮小預測準確性與證據基礎之間的差距，我們提出了REAL（嚴謹證據消融學習），這是一個促進依賴證據的驗證的訓練框架，通過反事實證據監督來支持LLM作為驗證者模型。在不同領域的四個事實查核數據集上的實驗表明，使用REAL訓練的模型相比於標準微調模型獲得了更優越的依賴證據能力。我們的研究結果強調，強大的事實查核表現仍然可以與弱證據依賴共存，而REAL則鼓勵真實性預測與支持證據的可用性保持更緊密的聯繫。
